short:
My practice combines the traditional science of Ayurveda with contemporary integrative wellness to create personalized health journeys based on each individual’s constitution, lifestyle, health concerns and goals.

My consultations include Prakriti & Vikriti assessment, Nadi Pariksha, detailed health and lifestyle evaluation, personalized Ayurvedic guidance, nutrition, daily routines, yoga, stress management and therapeutic wellness programmes, including Panchakarma where appropriate.

I work with clients seeking support for stress and burnout, digestive and metabolic wellbeing, sleep and energy, lifestyle-related imbalances, healthy ageing, recovery and overall vitality. Each programme is individually designed rather than based on a one-size-fits-all protocol.

With extensive experience in luxury wellness hospitality and international clientele, I combine authentic Ayurvedic principles with a professional, personalized and globally accessible approach—helping clients understand their health, make sustainable lifestyle changes and build lasting wellbeing.

My philosophy is simple: understand the individual, personalize the approach, and create sustainable change.
long: I provide personalized Ayurveda and Integrative Wellness consultations for international clients, combining traditional Ayurvedic assessment with nutrition, lifestyle guidance, yoga, Panchakarma and holistic wellness therapies. Each programme is tailored to the individual’s needs, health goals and constitution, with a focus on sustainable wellbeing, balance, vitality and preventive health.
